corrections: Translated and reread every remaining second-year fall16 dialogue record from source ordinals 80 through 93 directly from English, completing the asset.
Preserved every player, dialogue, emotion and asterisk marker; avoided assigning a gender to the Dwarf and retained each character’s distinct register.
Applied locked Stardew Valley, Уелуик and Звезден жетон terminology, refined the craftsmanship and human-gathering lines, and kept Willy’s fishing-game meaning centered on skill rather than chance.
